decisions.reason: The mitred handle family is still mentioned on the website in both years. Keeping it in an existing door hardware catalogue costs little, and the evidence so far does not reveal its value clearly enough to justify abandoning the option.
Moving from a mention to a page of its own in 2024 signals growing commitment. Its prospects look favourable, so the option is worth keeping open and expanding.
Its presence on the website is steady but low-key and its value is still uncertain. Because maintaining a single handle model costs little, the option is kept rather than abandoned.

Wins of the German Design Award and the iF Design Award, plus dedicated pages in both years, show that the collection's value is being realized. This justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
